headline: Recommends $446,949.85 Hampden County Sheriff's Department contract amendment, and a shared transportation budget for homeless students.
summary: The meeting covered school transportation, a Sheriff's Department contract for innovation schools, and the electric bus agreement with First Student. Members voted to recommend two items to the full committee. Talks on subcontracting and the bus agreement continued with no vote.
decisions: Recommended to the full committee a budget to share transportation costs for McKinney-Vento students, 2-0, with one member absent.
Recommended approval of Amendment six to City Contract 20150011 with the Hampden County Sheriff's Department, $446,949.85, 2-0, with one member absent.
discussion: Subcontracting with First Student: Members discussed whether the First Student contract could allow a small local vendor to subcontract. Insurance requirements were the main concern, and the attorney said city legal should review any change.

Electric bus agreement: Staff said First Student wants to revisit a clause that would turn over 25 buses to the district if it does not win the next contract. A meeting is being planned to reach a fair resolution.

Quarterly transportation reports: Members asked what information the committee should receive from First Student. Staff said on-time performance would be included, and a site visit to the bus company was discussed.
Sheriff's Department program: Members asked how the program differs from the school resource officer contract. Staff said the deputies check addresses and support truancy work and ride-throughs.

decision_evidence.quote: Are we ready to vote on this matter? So moved. All right. Trinny? Second. Miss Hurst? Absent. Miss Ronaeler? Yes. Miss Crawford? Yes. Sufficient votes. We'll bring it to the full committee.

I'd like to make a motion, Madam Chair, to vote to recommend to the full committee the approval of Amendment number six for City Contract number 20150011, intergovernmental agency agreement between the City of Springfield and the Hampden County Sheriff's Department in the amount of $446,949.85. ... Miss Ronaeler? Yes. Miss Crawford? Yes. Sufficient votes.
